# Module map

Every module in `src/reportal/`, the subsystem page that owns it, and the
purpose its own docstring states. The ownership column comes from each
page's `Sources:` line, so a module in no page or in two fails
`tests/test_docs_structure.py`.

The process layout in [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md#process-layout) is
the reading order across these modules; the
[subsystems index](subsystems/README.md) is the page-per-subsystem view.

| Module | Subsystem | Purpose |
|--------|-----------|---------|
| `__init__.py` | [runtime](subsystems/runtime.md) | reportal, a self-hosted reverse-engineering portal. |
| `__main__.py` | [runtime](subsystems/runtime.md) | ``python -m reportal`` entry point. |
| `_paths.py` | [configuration](subsystems/configuration.md) | Workspace path resolution for reportal. |
| `activity.py` | [analytics](subsystems/analytics.md) | The activity feed, derived rather than stored. |
| `agent.py` | [conversation](subsystems/conversation.md) | Agentic conversation runs: a tool loop over the local MCP registry. |
| `ai_decomp.py` | [ai-artifacts](subsystems/ai-artifacts.md) | The AI decompilation artifact: one rewritten function, its token map and rating. |
| `analysis_log.py` | [store](subsystems/store.md) | Structured analysis-log rows: one lifecycle event per row, with a severity. |
| `analytics.py` | [analytics](subsystems/analytics.md) | Time series over the rows reportal already stores. |
| `api.py` | [http-api](subsystems/http-api.md) | JSON API routes for reportal. |
| `archive.py` | [format-analysis](subsystems/format-analysis.md) | Archive extraction for stored binaries. |
| `attack_surface.py` | [static-scans](subsystems/static-scans.md) | The attack surface of one stored binary, derived from its stored scans. |
| `auth.py` | [identity-and-scope](subsystems/identity-and-scope.md) | Local identity: users, roles and bearer tokens, off until configured. |
| `auto_goal_worker.py` | [auto-mode](subsystems/auto-mode.md) | The goal-directed LLM worker: change a function toward a stated objective. |
| `auto_llm_worker.py` | [auto-mode](subsystems/auto-mode.md) | The engine-verified LLM worker: reconstruct one function's C from the model. |
| `auto_mode.py` | [auto-mode](subsystems/auto-mode.md) | Auto-mode orchestration: decompose a binary, fan out to workers, aggregate. |
| `auto_store.py` | [auto-mode](subsystems/auto-mode.md) | SQLite CRUD for auto mode: runs, the task tree they decompose into, and attempts. |
| `auto_workers.py` | [auto-mode](subsystems/auto-mode.md) | Worker registry for auto mode: what turns one function into a result. |
| `backup.py` | [operations](subsystems/operations.md) | Workspace backup and restore: one portable archive of everything local. |
| `behavior.py` | [static-scans](subsystems/static-scans.md) | Behavioral scans: deterministic execution, networking and filesystem heuristics. |
| `benchmark.py` | [matching](subsystems/matching.md) | Measuring how often a run finds the counterpart an analyst already knows. |
| `billing.py` | [tenancy-billing](subsystems/tenancy-billing.md) | Organisation subscription billing through Stripe. |
| `binary_actions.py` | [binary-actions](subsystems/binary-actions.md) | Journaled binary extract, carve and unpack actions. |
| `bulk_actions.py` | [binary-actions](subsystems/binary-actions.md) | Bulk actions over binaries and functions, shared by the API, CLI and MCP. |
| `capabilities.py` | [static-scans](subsystems/static-scans.md) | Capability tagging: classify what a binary can do from its imports and strings. |
| `cli.py` | [cli](subsystems/cli.md) | Typer CLI for reportal. |
| `clock.py` | [store](subsystems/store.md) | Shared UTC clock for reportal writers and readers. |
| `comments.py` | [conversation](subsystems/conversation.md) | Analyst comments: scope and body validation over the ``comments`` table. |
| `components.py` | [components](subsystems/components.md) | reportal's component framework: everything in a pipeline run is a component. |
| `composition.py` | [binary-detail](subsystems/binary-detail.md) | Composition analysis of one stored binary against its stored matches. |
| `conversations.py` | [conversation](subsystems/conversation.md) | Conversations over stored local data and the optional LLM bridge. |
| `credits.py` | [tenancy-billing](subsystems/tenancy-billing.md) | What each AI task costs a tenant, in credits. |
| `customer_cli.py` | [cli](subsystems/cli.md) | Customer CLI: the platform surface of reportal, over HTTP only. |
| `data_types.py` | [symbols-and-types](subsystems/symbols-and-types.md) | Editable data types: the local type model, its C rendering and its indices. |
| `debug.py` | [debug](subsystems/debug.md) | Read-only live-debug sessions over the Debug Adapter Protocol, off by default. |
| `decompiler_scripts.py` | [ai-artifacts](subsystems/ai-artifacts.md) | Decompiler round-trip scripts: stored renames as runnable tool scripts. |
| `details.py` | [binary-detail](subsystems/binary-detail.md) | The binary-detail reads the hosted portal derives from a scan. |
| `diffing.py` | [diff-and-lineage](subsystems/diff-and-lineage.md) | Line-level alignment of two listings for the portal's Match / Diff surface. |
| `diffview.py` | [diff-and-lineage](subsystems/diff-and-lineage.md) | Resolve a match pair to two listings and align them for the diff view. |
| `disclosure.py` | [identity-and-scope](subsystems/identity-and-scope.md) | What a tenant is allowed to see about how an answer was produced. |
| `docs.py` | [documentation](subsystems/documentation.md) | The in-app documentation browser: the shipped markdown as structured blocks. |
| `doctor.py` | [operations](subsystems/operations.md) | Pre-flight readiness: can this install serve, and what is missing if not. |
| `effects.py` | [components](subsystems/components.md) | The one effect dispatcher: what a run wrote, and how a revert takes it back. |
| `engines.py` | [engines](subsystems/engines.md) | In-process adapters for the reportal engine stack. |
| `error_docs.py` | [documentation](subsystems/documentation.md) | The error-code catalogue and the documentation URL every error body carries. |
| `exploitability.py` | [static-scans](subsystems/static-scans.md) | Finding reachability over the stored security scan. |
| `external.py` | [static-scans](subsystems/static-scans.md) | External sources: what a third party says about a stored binary. |
| `families.py` | [binary-detail](subsystems/binary-detail.md) | Local malware-family matching against a user-curated signature store. |
| `filetypes.py` | [format-analysis](subsystems/format-analysis.md) | Bundled file-type, packer and protector detection over data reportal fetches. |
| `firmware.py` | [format-analysis](subsystems/format-analysis.md) | Firmware carving: find the images embedded in a stored blob, offline. |
| `flirt_sigs.py` | [matching](subsystems/matching.md) | FLIRT signature catalog and the match cache in front of it. |
| `function_extras.py` | [binary-detail](subsystems/binary-detail.md) | The per-function extras: indirect call sites, capabilities, edges and names. |
| `function_triage.py` | [ai-artifacts](subsystems/ai-artifacts.md) | Per-function triage: an LLM summary and a suspicion score per function. |
| `gobuildinfo.py` | [format-analysis](subsystems/format-analysis.md) | Go build information recovery from the stored binary file. |
| `graph.py` | [knowledge](subsystems/knowledge.md) | Deterministic knowledge graph over rows reportal already stores. |
| `graph_backends.py` | [knowledge](subsystems/knowledge.md) | Pluggable knowledge-graph backends for the derived local graph. |
| `hardening.py` | [static-scans](subsystems/static-scans.md) | Deterministic hardening scans: anti-analysis and obfuscation heuristics. |
| `instance.py` | [runtime](subsystems/runtime.md) | What this reportal instance can do, for a client that has to ask. |

| `jobs.py` | [jobs](subsystems/jobs.md) | The asynchronous operation workflow: queued jobs with a status and a cancel. |

| `library.py` | [matching](subsystems/matching.md) | Library identification and the software bill of materials it feeds. |
| `lineage.py` | [diff-and-lineage](subsystems/diff-and-lineage.md) | Deterministic pairwise function lineage between two binaries. |
